mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 19 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 19, low 11.

NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg said Russia is losing more than 40,000 soldiers each month in the war against Ukraine, a rate higher than the total U.S. casualties in the entire Vietnam War.

A team of inspectors from the International Civil Aviation Organization has arrived in North Macedonia, marking the first ICAO review of the country's civil aviation in 17 years.

Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti, speaking at the European Political Community summit in Dublin, thanked Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin and the Irish people for sheltering Kosovo refugees expelled during the Milosevic era.

The Association of Municipalities of Kosovo has urged central authorities to provide concrete compensation for agricultural losses caused by natural disasters, noting that no payments have been made since 2023.

Tetovo-born kickboxer Muhammed Dauti was crowned world champion at the international tournament in Madrid, representing Wolf Kickboxing & MMA.
